claims.claim: US used Sigma 12-24 mm lens for Canon camera.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a black camera lens with ribbed rings and a hood, but the exact brand/model text and the mount type are not clearly readable; no confirmation it is Sigma 12-24mm or Canon-mount.

claims.claim: The lens looks new and in perfect working condition.
claims.evidence: Photos show the lens exterior and hood, but the report does not include clear evidence of glass condition (scratches/fungus/haze/oil) or functional testing (AF/aperture/IS).

claims.claim: Shutter count under 5,000, no fungus or scratch on the lens.
claims.evidence: A lens does not have a shutter count; the photos do not show fungus/scratches/haze status with certainty.

claims.claim: Original battery and charger, never repaired.
claims.evidence: The item appears to be a lens; the witness photos do not show any battery/charger, and there is no repair history evidence.

risks.risk: Wrong brand/model or wrong mount (Canon compatibility not confirmed).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the lens front ring/model text and a photo of the mount/bayonet area showing the mount type (e.g., Canon EF).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used wide-angle lens with unknown mount/compatibility (buyer risk of mismatch).

risks.risk: Hidden glass defects (fungus, haze, oil, scratches) not visible in the provided angles.
risks.proof: Close-up shots of the front and rear glass against a bright light (flashlight/phone torch) plus a photo of both glass surfaces at multiple angles.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not-fully-verified optical condition (assume possible haze/fungus risk).

risks.risk: Functional issues (autofocus/aperture control/zoom or focus ring smoothness) not tested.
risks.proof: A short video showing autofocus lock on a target and aperture actuation through the camera, plus a clip demonstrating smooth zoom/focus movement.
risks.if_unproven: Price as working-unknown (assume worst-case: AF/aperture may be unreliable).

risks.risk: Missing accessories/caps/hood/filter or hood not original.
risks.proof: Photos of everything included: front cap, rear cap, lens hood, any filter, pouch/box, and a clear view of the hood branding.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete kit (caps/accessories not guaranteed).

risks.risk: Potential mismatch between seller narrative and actual item (e.g., not Sigma 12-24mm).
risks.proof: A clear, readable shot of the exact model name/number on the barrel and the serial number label (if present).
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case identification (treat as unidentified wide-angle lens).

proof_requests: Send a clear, readable photo of the lens brand and exact model text on the barrel (front ring and side).
Send a photo of the mount/bayonet area to confirm it is Canon-compatible (e.g., EF mount) and not another mount.
Send close-up photos of the front and rear glass against a bright light to check for fungus, haze, oil, and scratches.
Send a short video: autofocus lock test on a camera + demonstration that aperture changes correctly (stop down) and that focus/zoom rings move smoothly.
Confirm included items with photos: front cap, rear cap, lens hood, any filter, pouch/box, and whether the hood is original.
Provide serial number photo and any proof of purchase/warranty (if available).
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a camera lens with a hood, but the critical details needed to price safely (exact Sigma 12-24mm model and Canon mount, and verified optical/functional condition) are not readable or proven in the report. Request the specific proof shots/tests before pricing.
